teacher_info.about_teacher: I have been working as an English and Greek teacher for 16 years. I have a Bachelor's degree in English Language and Linguistics, a Master's degree in Special Education and a DELTA diploma (Diploma in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages) awarded from Cambridge University. I have also spent two years studying Media Assisted Language Teaching at Brighton University. I have taught young learners, teenagers and adults and I have experience in teaching General English, Business English, Conversation and Exam Preparation classes. I have worked as a private tutor but also as an English teacher in language schools, international summer schools in Europe and in public schools in Greece.
teacher_info.teaching_style: When I teach I try to guide students and give them opportunities to explore and discover language. The activities I plan are interactive and I make use of a variety of teaching material, such as power point presentations, handouts, online quizzes, videos, different kinds of texts and books. I consider the implementation of authentic material and real life tasks to be of great importance. Depending on each student's individual needs I create lessons that give learners the opportunity to practice and improve all four skills (reading, writing, speaking, listening) and great emphasis is also placed on grammar and vocabulary.

course_info.trial_description: A trial lesson is a great opportunity for me to get to know you better and to get a better idea of your needs, level and motivation. pro_course_detail.title: Conversation practice/ Προφορική εξάσκηση
pro_course_detail.description: This course is for learners who already know Greek (A2 level and above) and wish to further practice their speaking skills while talking about a variety of topics. This is an excellent opportunity to improve fluency, accuracy and learn new vocabulary.

pro_course_detail.title: Greek Grammar
pro_course_detail.description: Greek grammar is an area that most learners find really challenging. In this lesson we do various tasks based on any grammatical phenomenon that you might be struggling with. Tasks are interactive and communicative. Our first aim is to help you understand form and use and then practice using each phenomenon in various communicative situations.

pro_course_detail.title: Reading and Pronunciation
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson focuses on reading and pronunciation. You will have the opportunity to read various types of authentic texts and Greek literature, learn new vocabulary and improve your pronunciation. I will also provide you with extra practice in sounds and letters that you find the most challenging.

pro_course_detail.title: Exam Preparation
pro_course_detail.description: This course prepares you for any Greek language exam you wish to sit for and provides you with all the information and support you need in order to successfully pass the examination.

pro_course_detail.title: All skills
pro_course_detail.description: This course focuses on all skills (speaking, listening, writing, reading, pronunciation, spelling). Every time the lesson focuses on a combination of skills around the same topic. There is a set curriculum, a variety of both learning and authentic material and homework tasks (if the learner wishes so). The topics are adapted based on your level and the reasons you are learning the language. Communication is of primary importance and that is why speaking fluency and accuracy are a priority in every single lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description: In this course you will have the opportunity to practice speaking in a variety of topics which will be chosen based on your interests and learning goals. Other material can also be used (articles, movies, videos, books) as the basis for discussion.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description: This course helps you master all skills of the English language. Working with a combination of books designed for English learners and authentic material you can learn the language from scratch, refresh your existing knowledge or improve areas that you find challenging (grammar, vocabulary, writing, reading, listening, speaking). The course is tailored to your personal needs and goal and you are provided with support before, during and after each lesson.

teacher_info.teaching_style: I prefer question driven teaching (coming from both the student and teacher), in order to stimulate curiosity. Moreover, I believe that education needs to be adapted to each student's needs, hence I am as flexible as possible and my teaching material will follow a creative flow.

pro_course_detail.title: Travel-Survival
pro_course_detail.description:
Get ready to explore Georgia with confidence! 🌍 In the Travel-Survival lesson, you’ll master essential Georgian phrases and vocabulary tailored for travelers. From greeting locals and ordering delicious Georgian dishes to asking for directions and navigating public transport, this lesson is your ultimate toolkit for surviving—and thriving—on your journey.

Designed to be fun, interactive, and practical, the Travel-Survival lesson ensures you feel at ease in real-life situations. Whether you’re visiting Tbilisi’s bustling markets, hiking in Kazbegi, or exploring hidden gems, you’ll have the language skills to connect and make your trip unforgettable.

Pack your bags and let’s embark on this adventure together!

teacher_info.intro: My name is Sofia and I come from Thessaloniki, Greece. I am a graduate of the Hellenic-American Union (Department of Translation and Linguistics) and I am licensed by the Ministry of Education and Religious Affairs. After many years of studying and attaining professional and academic qualifications, I commenced my professional teaching career in my home country. For 20 years I worked as a full time teacher of English and Greek, tutoring both children and adults, providing both online and face-to-face classes according to the needs of my students. Now, based in the UK, I continue to provide the same educational services to children and adults.
teacher_info.introduction:
My name is Sofia and I come from Thessaloniki, Greece. I am a graduate of the Hellenic-American Union (Department of Translation and Linguistics). I have professional and academic qualifications in both teaching and translation and I am licensed by the Ministry of Education and Religious Affairs. I have been teaching English for 17 years now and Greek since 2013.  

As a teacher with 17 years professional experience I continuously strive to build rapport with my students, creating a trusting atmosphere and paying constant attention to individual strengths, weaknesses, and learning styles. I offer a tailored learning experience in which the lesson is a dynamic and interactive process. I am very proud of my students and I adore my job. It always makes me very happy to see them making progress, constantly advancing in their understanding of the language and attaining further self-confidence in its application, and I never cease to be amazed by how much one's life changes when one masters a new language. Equally exciting for me is the way in which new opportunities open up for my students both in their personal and professional lives.

pro_course_detail.title: FCE and General English
pro_course_detail.description:
Preparation for the First Certificate in English. Reading, Writing, Speaking, Grammar and Listening.
 We will be practicing on authentic material for the Reading comprehension part of the test. 
Learn about all types of writing that are required for the test and how to write properly. 
Learn speaking expressions and practice pronunciation and what is expected of you from examiners. 
Practice listening and learn tips and tricks on how not to be intimidated by the listening exam. 
Explain grammar rules and practice common use of English tasks.
For the General English course you can choose which one of the five skill you would like to improve and we will focus on that.

pro_course_detail.title: CAE
pro_course_detail.description:
The Cambridge CAE is at CERF level C1. 
The format is the same as in FCE so there is Speaking, Listening, Reading, Writing and Grammar; only at this level we will be focussing on expanding our vocabulary - synonyms, antonyms - and practicing more specific grammar items, like passive voice, mixed conditionals, inversion and clauses.

pro_course_detail.title: CPE
pro_course_detail.description:
CPE is at CERF level C2. 
Again there will be practice on the test format. Listening, Speaking, Writing, Reading and Use of English. 
Proficiency is a lot of vocabulary exercises and a deeper understanding of the English language. It is English at academic level; the difference between spoken and written English.

pro_course_detail.title: A1-A2 -Beginner courses
pro_course_detail.description:
Beginner courses are the basic tenses of English language. Present Simple, Present Continuous, Past Simple, Past Continuous, Present Perfect, Present Perfect Continuous, Past Perfect, Past Perfect Continuous, Future Simple, Future Continuous, Future Perfect, Future Perfect Continuous and Be going to. 
And simple every day vocabulary.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS
pro_course_detail.description:
There are two IELTS exams, one is Academic and the other is General Training. 
There is a scale and your target should be the scale that is required of you from the organisation you are applying to. 
We will focus on general English Grammar and vocabulary but we will also practice the specific tasks that the test requires, aiming at a higher score than the one set by the institution you are targeting.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I can do all the things you expect a teacher to do, but I see myself as a mirror: 
your improvement and progress is entirely up to 
~ you 
~ how enthusiastic you are about the language you study
~ and your motivations.

In our conversations, the environment is always a welcome one. Make mistakes. Take your time, express yourself freely. After all, most of the interaction with a tutor is never about the subject you learn, 
but about the connection you have and how comfortable you feel.

Make decisions as to how you want the lessons to go;
a teacher is a resource, so use it to your advantage.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
In order to progress, you need to have a crystal clear goal as to ~ w h y ~ you’re learning a language. 
This is how you help yourself get to this goal quickly and efficiently, 
but you also let your teacher know the best way they can help you.

And like with any other skill, learning requires patience and practice.
There has never been, and there never will be a quick fix or magic method to this.

*pro tip*
After you’ve done some language studying, go to sleep.
Thank me later. :D

pro_course_detail.title: greek conversation ☀️
pro_course_detail.description:
As a greek myself, I always thought that there would be no interest in our language beyond the borders of our humble country.

Yet, the more I teach, the more I see that there is a big number of people who want to learn for different reasons. Descendants of greeks and want to connect to their roots, language enthusiasts who love the way greek sounds, Christians who want to read the greek Bible, travellers who want to be able to order a true ‘gyro’ in Greece. 

It warms my little heart to meet all these people who are willing to engage with the culture and with the language, and through their eyes I can appreciate where I come from even more.

Not to mention, trying to explain ‘bouzoukia’ to foreigners is a level of fun I never thought I’d experience.

So whether you are learning for travel, for work, for being able to read the Odyssey in its original text (a noble goal, if I say so myself) or just because it's just endlessly amusing, it will be my absolute pleasure to help you with γρεεκ.

pro_course_detail.title: english conversation ☕
pro_course_detail.description:
🍎 ΙΝΤERMEDIATE + ADVANCED STUDENTS
_________________________________________________________________________

Ah, the One Language to rule them all, 
the Queen of international human communication, 
the Khaleesi of the West Germanic Languages, 
her Majesty, her Royal Highness, 
~ English ~ .

She is multifaceted, multicultural and multifunctional,
tender, tolerant, eccentric and exceptional.

She won’t let you pronounce ‘tough’ , ‘though’ and ‘thought’ the same 
but she will give you no verb endings to remember, 
except the ‘he, she, or it’: I play, we play but he plays. 
‘’Remember the -s’’, said the generous Ruler.

She will accept all her children,
Latin, French, Greek, Swahili, German, 
and all the gifts they bring her: 
audio, silhouette, panopticon, jenga, angst.

Long live the Queen! 👑
